steps.note: Vos sells his copy of the code card (a kit item), then Fonoti at the lock stands down when told Vos sold him out.

said: I don't do philosophy. I do delivery dates.
That guard has the code card. I have a copy, and you can have it.
His name is Fonoti, the big one at the lock end.
notSaid: Evening. Nobody comes up the stair this late.

said: Nobody comes up the stair this late. They told me somebody would tonight.
I'm off shift, far as I'm concerned. Go on through.
Mind the grating by the stair. It's loose.
